How PENSY works and where to go to get things done. The practical information is general and can vary from region to region: for special cases ask the office in charge.
The main things in one minute

I keep your paperwork in order: bills, car tax, medical reports, prescriptions, payslips. I turn them into text, remind you of deadlines and tell you how much is left at the end of the month. Everything stays on your phone: I don\'t use the internet.
Take a photo, I\'ll do the rest

Tap «Add» and take a photo, or import a PDF. I read the amount, the due date, the pagoPA code and QR codes. You check and save. Usually I delete the photo and keep text and codes; if you need it, I keep it.
Home, Car, Health, Pets, School, Work, Taxes. I put each document in the right place on my own and learn from your corrections. Inside you can create subfolders: Health › Heart, Car › Panda.
I remind you 10 days before, the day before and on the day. The calendar shows everything, with the amounts. At the counter you show the QR code straight from the phone.
Your health, ready at the doctor\'s

In the Health folder you\'ll find conditions, allergies, medicines with their times, visits done, booked and to book. I remind you when to take your medicines and when to order them. At the doctor\'s, tap «Show to the doctor».
How much is left this month
Add your payslip and everyday spending: I tell you what you have left, which months will be heavy and how much to put aside in savings jars. You can keep your children\'s or a parent\'s papers too.
Choose a folder: I keep an encrypted copy there, PENSY_DATA. If you change phone, copy it and import it. Any doubt? Tap the question mark at the top of the «Today» screen.
PENSY closed because of an error
Tap «Copy» and paste the text below in the chat with Claude: it helps fix the problem. It says where in the program it happened.

resources.string: How do you want to add it?
Take a photo of a report or prescription
I keep your bills, documents, health and money in order. Take a photo or upload a PDF: I read amounts and due dates and remind you in time. Everything stays on your phone, with no internet.
Have you used PENSY on another phone?
Bring everything back from the PENSY_DATA folder or a .pensy file: documents, deadlines, health and budget.
Who do you use PENSY for?
You can also keep the papers of the people you look after. Each person has their own deadlines, folders and health record; switch between them with the circle at the top right.
Also for a son or daughter
Name of the son or daughter
Also for a parent or someone you care for
Add more people whenever you like from Settings › People.

PENSY does not use the internet: your data stays only on the phone. Choose a folder and I will keep an encrypted copy there, PENSY_DATA, protected by a password you pick. If you change phone, copy it and lose nothing.
You can do it later too: I will remind you on the Today screen.

Here you see deadlines day by day, with amounts and the ones that repeat. Tap a day to see what is on it.
The budget brings together payslips, deadlines and spending: see how much is left, which months will be heavy and how much you put aside. Tap a bar to see that month.
The health record: conditions, allergies, medicines with their times, visits and measurements. At the doctor\'s, tap «Show to the doctor» to have everything on one page, also as a PDF.
